name: @borjie/media-engine
description: Standalone media-generation ENGINE. ProviderPort over IMAGE (Imagen-3 / FLUX / Seedream-class), SHORT-VIDEO (Sora-2 / Veo-3 / Seedance-2-class) and GIF/animation providers; provider registry with one deterministic in-repo stub provider so it runs with zero API keys; real HTTP adapters behind injected config (keys never read from process.env). Prompt-safety gate, watermark + C2PA provenance stamp, async job model, storage PORT (signed-URL delivery), and cost guards. Typed media-request kinds for Borjie mining-estate and BN real-estate. Ports exposed for later modality-arbiter wiring; not wired into the brain.
